metadata.title: AgriN Pan-India Expanded Agricultural Knowledge Catalogue
metadata.geographic_coverage: All 28 Indian States & 8 Union Territories (15 ICAR Agro-Climatic Zones)
institutional_sources: DES (Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture)
ICRISAT (International Crops Research Institute for the Semi-Arid Tropics)
State Agricultural Universities (MPKV, VNMKV, TNAU, PAU, UASB)
metadata.disclaimer: This knowledge catalogue provides reference agronomic baselines and regional suitability filters. It must not be treated as empirical field training observations.
